statement_en: Let $E_1,E_2,\dots \in\mathcal{F}$ be mutually independent, and suppose that $\mathbb{P}(E_n)<1$. Then $$\mathbb{P}(\cup_{n\geq 1}E_n)=1\implies \mathbb{P}(E_n \text{ i.o.})=1.$$
key_techniques: reformulation of the second Borel-Cantelli lemma
callout_body: 合列$E_1,..,E_n,..\in\mathcal{F}$互相之间是独立的，并且$\mathbb{P}(E_n)<1$那么$$\mathbb{P}(\cup_{n\geq 1}E_n)=1\implies \mathbb{P}(E_n \text{ i.o.})=1$$
